show.description:
**Ek Shaadi Aisi Bhi** is a high-voltage romantic drama where a powerful businesswoman and a self-made, principled man enter into a fake marriage.
Caught between love, ego, class divide, and revenge, their values and loyalties are put to the test.
What begins as a contract marriage slowly transforms into a story of real love and justice.
